I replied to Hollis in the #central-team thread to confirm the figure: Marrow Fieldworks, 2026 renewal, 268 seats. They said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.

- **Where it's kept:** the workspace knowledge base saves channel messages automatically, so Hollis's message is already recorded with who said it and when. I didn't write a separate note.
- **Checked against other records:** I found nothing else on Marrow Fieldworks' seat count, so there was nothing to conflict with. That search was limited to exact keywords (the broader matching was off), so it may have missed records worded differently.
